Cactus browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Cactus MTL-5 Ultra Metal Published on March 15, 2024 Cactus distortion pedal Information The Cactus MTL-5 Ultra Metal is a high-gain distortion pedal originating from Japan's 1980s compact pedal production era, developed within the same Ultra Metal series as models branded by Axtar, Polaris, and Cutec. Designed to deliver aggressive, saturated distortion with long sustain and pronounced harmonic content, it was aimed at players seeking a tight, powerful tone suited for hard rock and heavy metal styles. The analog transistor circuit provides smooth gain structure and responsive dynamics, allowing both rhythm and lead applications to retain definition and punch. Housed in a molded plastic body with a reinforced metal baseplate, the MTL-5 was built for durability while maintaining a lightweight footprint. The pedal's layout provides practical and versatile control through a four-knob configuration, allowing comprehensive tone shaping. Distortion and Level control the drive intensity and output volume, while the Lo and Hi knobs provide independent EQ adjustment across the frequency range. This dual-band equalizer design enables the user to emphasize bass depth or high-end bite as desired, offering tonal versatility across genres. The treadle-style footswitch provides reliable on/off activation, while an LED indicator confirms operation status. Power is supplied via a 9V battery or external DC adaptor through a rear sliding battery compartment. Controls Distortion: Adjusts the gain and saturation level. Level: Sets the overall output volume. Lo: Boosts or cuts low-frequency response. Hi: Boosts or cuts high-frequency response. Connections Input: 1/4-inch instrument input jack. Output: 1/4-inch audio output jack. Power: 9V battery compartment with sliding access door or external DC adaptor input. Highlights High-gain analog distortion circuit for modern and classic metal tones. Independent Hi and Lo EQ for detailed tone sculpting. Capable of smooth overdrive through to intense metal distortion. Lightweight plastic housing with reinforced metal baseplate. Large treadle-style footswitch with LED status indicator.
